baseline.policy: Hold cash, SPY, or QQQ at the identical 4000 USD notional over each row's identical next-open-to-tenth-session-close window; retain current cash/no-new-entry behavior.

execution_envelope.borrow_dependency: None; no short or leveraged instrument.
execution_envelope.capacity_constraint: No capital is allocated; the probe cannot exceed settled ledger rows.
execution_envelope.costs_and_carry: Gross fixed-4000-USD replacement-value diagnostics; no new cost assumption.
execution_envelope.liquidity_dependency: Only already-settled rows with canonical OHLCV prices are read.
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: Observer first-seen precedes next-session-open entry; settlement ends at H10.

expectation_gap.gap_definition: The price prior treats mapped equities as already reflecting public headlines, while the fixed bundle claims incomplete transmission across private entities, policy, infrastructure, healthcare, and crypto resolves over ten sessions.

independent_evidence.provenance: Prospectively logged observer rows under the unchanged source manifest; current-cohort values remain inaccessible until start.

market_prior.provenance: Decision-time entry prices and same-notional cash, SPY, and QQQ H10 opportunity-cost comparators.

transmission.catalyst: A public headline matched by one of the six frozen entity/theme queries and joined to the fixed public-equity map before the next regular-session open.
transmission.expected_direction: Broadly positive replacement value versus cash, SPY, and QQQ, with at least four of six query groups positive versus both ETFs.
transmission.half_life: Exactly ten trading sessions from next regular-session open.

candidates.falsifier: Reject unless there are at least 250 settled rows and exactly six query groups; row means versus cash, SPY, and QQQ are all positive; all three row medians are nonnegative; observed-date means versus all three comparators are positive; at least four query groups are positive versus both SPY and QQQ; maximum positive-cash query share is at most 60%; and maximum positive-cash ticker share is at most 40%. Any failure rejects, with no slice or retune.
candidates.hypothesis: With 114541 settled rows, versus 73275 at exp-20260729-006 and the frozen 109913 reopen bar, the unchanged six-query entity/theme news bundle may now show broad H10 replacement value versus cash, SPY, and QQQ; no query, ticker map, horizon, notional, threshold, response, ranking, sizing, exit, order, paper, or live behavior may change.
candidates.replacement_value_comparator: Same-notional, same-window cash, SPY, and QQQ holds for every row.
candidates.title: Fixed entity-theme bundle Axis-C attribution at 114541 settled rows

treatment.policy: Re-evaluate only the exact fixed source bundle on the newly matured settled cohort.

candidates.why_not_arbitraged: This is an attribution-only observer with imperfect search-vintage provenance, heterogeneous relevance, repeated headlines, and coarse private-entity-to-public-equity mappings. Prior reads failed benchmark-relative breadth and no capital is allocated.
